archetypes.name: dyn-skill-desc
archetypes.rationale: Skill registry descriptions are compressed and affect trigger quality.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed SKILL.md frontmatter descriptions for trigger fidelity after compression. Check that each value stays in Use when form, keeps the main action and scope, and does not imply behavior beyond the skill body. Pay special attention to public versus dev-only skill wording. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-desc-lint
archetypes.rationale: A new custom lint parses frontmatter description values.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new skill-description-length lint and tests. Focus on frontmatter boundary handling, quoted and unquoted values, inline comment stripping, length measurement, and exit-code behavior through lint_common. Confirm the CLI, Makefile, and pre-commit wiring all invoke the same command. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
